slf.review: 411 used to be easier when slf sir was taking it, but sadly sir will not take this course anymore.

I'm grateful to NSU because of Slf and ADF sir as they helped me a lot to enhance my career as a Database Administrator. I was a frustrated student bearing the burden of a below 3 CGPA, who had zero skills for his future. I took CSE 411 in my 13th semester, and that changed my life completely. After finishing Advanced Database, I knew what I wanted to do in my life. I got a precise idea about the banking database system and how database is used in a big company. That was the most precious 24 classes I have ever attended. What SLf sir can offer you:
1. A lot of interview questions (read his slides carefully).
2. A concise idea about the database management system.
3. Ask him more questions. You will know about industry-level database management.
4. believe me, you are not a rookie after finishing 411 with SLf.
5. Don't take help from ChatGPT and try to complete his project by your own. You will see the difference.
Most friendly,most understandable teacher in nsu
